description: Convert an XML string or base64 XML/RSS/Atom/SOAP/SVG/UBL file into clean, validated JSON or JSON Lines (.jsonl). Supports smart number/boolean/xsi:nil detection (while preserving leading-zero ZIP/IDs as strings), configurable attribute prefix (@, _, plain or omit), XML namespace stripping or prefix retention, force-array tag lists, keep/unwrap root, and pretty or minified output. Deterministic (XXE-safe lxml), 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/xml-to-json.

alwaysArray.description: Optional comma-separated tag names (or array of strings) to always output as JSON arrays even when only 1 item exists

attributeMode.description: How XML attributes become JSON keys: @id, _id, id, or ignore

detectTypes.description: Convert numbers, true/false and xsi:nil='true' while keeping leading-zero IDs as strings

emptyTagMode.description: Empty element (<tag/>) value: null or empty string

format.description: Pretty-printed JSON, single-line minified JSON, or JSON Lines (.jsonl)

keepRoot.description: Keep the root XML tag as the top-level JSON key

stripNamespaces.description: Remove XML namespace URIs from tag names

xml.description: XML text to convert (empty = built-in sample order catalog)

name: xml_to_json
title: XML to JSON API - convert XML, RSS, SOAP or UBL into structured JSON
